refnamediv.refpurpose: Configuration for device event managing daemon

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: udevd8 expects its main configuration file at /etc/udev/udev.conf. It consists of a set of variables allowing the user to override default udev values. All empty lines or lines beginning with '#' are ignored. The following variables can be set:

listitem.para: The log level. Valid values are the numerical syslog priorities or their textual representations: err, info and debug.
The format of the compiled hardware database hwdb.bin created by udevadm hwdb --update. Valid values are 1 and 2, invalid values are ignored with a warning. Defaults to 1.

Format 1 is the compatible format, which can be read by all versions of libudev. When a device matches multiple entries of the hardware database which set the same property, it is undefined which of the values is used.

Format 2 additionally stores the origin (the source file and the line number) of every property, so that for the same property the value from a later file or a later line takes precedence. This format can only be read by libudev from this release or newer: older versions of libudev, including an old udevd which was not restarted after an upgrade, misread such a database.
When udevadm hwdb --update is used with --root=, the value is taken from udev.conf below the specified root directory instead, and defaults to 1 if it is not set there.

Takes a boolean argument (yes, true, 1 or no, false, 0). Defaults to no. Selects how the path_id builtin composes the SAS part of ID_PATH, and thus the /dev/disk/by-path/ links, of devices behind a SAS port whose num_phys attribute is not 1.

By default only ports with two or more phys are treated as wide ports and named after the SAS address of the end device: sas-0xADDRESS-lun-N. Ports reporting zero phys, as done e.g. by the smartpqi driver, are named like single phy ports after the phy they are connected to: sas-phyPHY-lun-N, or sas-exp0xADDRESS-phyPHY-lun-N when connected through an expander. If num_phys cannot be parsed, no ID_PATH is set.

If set to yes, the naming of older eudev versions is used: every port with a num_phys other than 1, including 0 and unparsable values, is treated as a wide port and named sas-0xADDRESS-lun-N. This keeps existing by-path links of such controllers stable. The file is only read when udevd starts, and the links of already present devices are updated only when their events are processed again, e.g. by udevadm trigger.

refsect1.para: In addition, udevd can be configured by command-line options and the kernel command line (see udevd8).
